confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Yogyakarta's budget-to-mid-range tourist pricing; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant meal anchors are the most reliable. Beer, cocktail, and wine are less certain because alcohol is limited and priced inconsistently in Yogyakarta. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship (bar and restaurant markups over draft beer) because direct knowledge is weak. Accommodation tiers are bounded estimates for the July 2026 window. The FX observation is from RBA search results that show 0.6947 for 16 Oct 2026, but the page metadata was inconsistent, so the figure should be confirmed against the RBA page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other mid-sized Indonesian and mainland Southeast Asian tourist cities (budget-to-mid-range guesthouse, warung, and cafe pricing) with the same general cost structure.
